correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the exact Nyström preconditioned condition ratio to active-plane trace and determinant, factors the sign exactly, establishes a unique positive polynomial root, integrates the exact Haar-plane coordinate law, and verifies null endpoints and dimension-minimality. No finite experiment is substituted for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The smallest genuinely nontrivial Gaussian Nyström spectral preconditioner can make a linear system strictly more ill-conditioned. A sharp positive probability, its L^-2 decay, and the dimension-minimality boundary quantify a real algorithmic risk absent from broad expected-error analyses. The specific event is motivated by sensitivity of PCG conditioning, not by an arbitrary numerically chosen parameter slice.
